annotations.title: Close my net exposure to a coin across exchanges

description: Bring the net position in one coin across every exchange (long minus short) to zero, or to keep_fraction of it, by closing the larger side with reduce-only market orders, largest position first. It never opens a position: being long on one exchange and short on another stays as a hedge. Use when the person asks to hedge, flatten or cut their overall exposure to a coin. Not for one position (use close_position). Third-party apps reduce only positions they opened. Input: symbol, optional keep_fraction. A close cannot be undone. Next: get_my_positions (its net).

book.description: real (exchange accounts) or sandbox; needed only when the coin is held in both

keep_fraction.description: How much of the net to keep, a fraction: 0 = net flat (the default), 0.5 = halve it

name: close_net_exposure
